Phase-4.name: Release engineering and operations
Phase-4.description: Wave 4/5: ship MyGRACE like a product — a LIVE DeepSeek Harness status panel, a tag-driven release workflow with provenance, an artifact dry-run gate, a cross-platform CI matrix, and the actual npm publication (pending owner action). The package is publish-ready but not published.

step-1.description: LIVE DSH status panel (W4.1): setup install --panel installs a real host route GET /api/mygrace.status + browser card reading `mygrace status --format json`; graceful {ok:false,error} on every failure.

step-2.description: release.yml: tag v* / workflow_dispatch; release:check → publish:dry (artifact gate) → pack tarball → GitHub Release (no npm publication, owner decision 2026-11-25).

step-3.description: publish:dry artifact gate: pack → extract → static import completeness → packaged CLI smoke → offline install.

step-4.description: CI OS matrix: typecheck/tests on ubuntu-latest, windows-latest and macos-latest; multi-language job stays separate.

step-5.description: npm publication cancelled by the owner (2026-11-25): distribution is GitHub Releases + source; release.yml packs the tarball and creates the GitHub Release, with no registry credentials.

step-6.description: v3.1 optional external inputs: MWG detection, ADR-11 lint providers and ADR-12 guidance packs with trust-gated CLI execution and example packs.

outcome.item-1: The DSH web sidebar shows real project counts, lint badges and the trust verdict instead of a decorative placeholder.
outcome.item-2: Publishing is tag-driven and CI-only: gates run first, artifacts are verified offline, provenance is recorded.
outcome.item-3: A manual dry_run run exercises every gate without publishing.
outcome.item-4: The package installs from npm with the same behaviour as the source checkout (single publishable package).

deliverables.item-1: packages/mygrace-status-panel: private host plugin + browser card, installed by setup install --panel only.
deliverables.item-2: .github/workflows/release.yml with tag/version consistency check and trusted-publishing credentials path.
deliverables.item-3: scripts/publish-dry-run.ts wired as `bun run publish:dry` and `bun run release:full`.
deliverables.item-4: CONTRIBUTING.md "### Releasing mygrace-cli (GitHub Releases, no npm)": semver policy, tag flow, release gates and artifact creation.
deliverables.item-5: GitHub Release with the packed CLI tarball (npm publication cancelled by the owner).

acceptance-gates.item-1: `bun run release:check` and `bun run publish:dry` pass locally before any tag is cut.
acceptance-gates.item-2: `bun run publish:dry` reports the expected file list and verifies the packed CLI offline; no registry credentials exist.
acceptance-gates.item-3: release.yml refuses to publish when the tag differs from the package.json version.
acceptance-gates.item-4: setup install --uninstall removes the panel row byte-for-byte; a broken panel never breaks the GUI.
acceptance-gates.item-5: README keeps "from source/tarball" installation until the owner publishes, then switches to npm.

evidence.item-1: test/grace-panel.test.ts: payload builder, route registration/disposal, client bundle contract, install/uninstall composition, and dsh --profile web --dump-config against a temp DSH home.
evidence.item-2: test/grace-install-e2e.test.ts: idempotent install, byte-identical uninstall, failed-component exit codes.
evidence.item-3: Live browser evidence is limited: the route shape/registration and profile composition were verified against the real DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 loader, but a live `dsh web` session is not exercised in CI — documented as a limit in README.

risks.item-1: npm publication is irreversible for a version: the tag/version gate and publish:dry must run first.
risks.item-2: No npm publication: distribution is the GitHub Release tarball; registry credentials are intentionally absent from CI.
risks.item-3: The panel depends on DSH 0.2.x APIs; a DSH upgrade must be re-verified against the real loader.
risks.item-4: The version must be bumped in package.json and CHANGELOG before tagging, or release.yml stops the release.

dependencies.item-1: Phase-3 gate: all 25 modules verified, `mygrace ci --path .` PASS, validators green.
dependencies.item-2: Owner controls the GitHub tag/release; npm publication is cancelled (no registry account involved).
dependencies.item-3: Release gates in CONTRIBUTING.md §"Releasing" describe the exact hand-off sequence.
